{{Top|leg}}
'''Mono-filament trace-wires''' were used as part of the [[HB-4 Projectile Rifle]]'s targeting system. When a projectile was fired from the weapon, the mono-filament trace-wire would trail out. The rifle then fed flight information to the projectile through the trace-wire.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
